about.quote: The best gifts aren't bought — they're created with intention, love, and a personal touch.
about.missionP1: EziHubb was born from a simple belief: the most meaningful gifts are the ones made uniquely for someone. We design every product ourselves and print it on demand — nothing sits pre-made in a warehouse.
about.missionP2: Every order goes through the same careful process, from design to production to shipping, so the mug, canvas print, or tumbler you receive was made specifically for you.
about.missionP3: We believe personalization is more than printing a name. It's capturing a moment, honoring a relationship, and creating something that will be treasured for years to come.

stillHaveQuestions.title: Still have questions?
stillHaveQuestions.desc: Our support team responds within 2 hours on business days.

q1.q: How do I personalize a product?
q1.a: After choosing a product, click "Personalize Now" to open our customizer. You can add names, upload photos, choose styles, and enter messages. You'll see a real-time preview before adding to cart.

q2.q: What file formats are accepted for photo uploads?
q2.a: We accept JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC (iPhone photos). For best results, use a photo with at least 1000×1000 pixels. We'll let you know if the quality is too low.

q3.q: Can I order a product without personalization?
q3.a: Most of our products are designed to be personalized, but some can be ordered as-is. Products with an "Add to Cart" button (without personalization required) can be purchased immediately.

q4.q: Can I make changes to my order after placing it?
q4.a: Yes — but only within 2 hours of ordering. After that, production may have started and changes aren't possible. Contact us immediately at support@ezihubb.com for changes.

q5.q: Do you accept custom orders not shown on the website?
q5.a: Yes! We love custom orders. Contact us via the Contact page and describe what you're looking for. We handle custom orders for events, corporate gifting, and bulk orders.

q1.a: Most items are produced within 3–7 business days after ordering. Rush production (1–2 days) is available at checkout for most products.

q2.q: What materials and printing methods do you use?
q2.a: It depends on the product. Mugs are ceramic with dye-sublimation printing. Canvas prints use giclée UV printing on poly-cotton canvas. Apparel uses DTG (direct-to-garment) printing on premium cotton. Specific details are on each product page.

q3.q: What if the quality of my order doesn't meet expectations?
q3.a: We stand behind every item. If you're not satisfied, contact us within 30 days with a photo of the issue and we'll send a free replacement or provide a full refund — no questions asked.

q1.a: Standard shipping takes 5–10 business days after production. Express shipping (2–3 days) is available. International shipping takes 14–21 business days.

q2.a: Yes! Orders over $50 ship free. International orders over $100 qualify for discounted shipping. Free shipping is automatically applied at checkout.

q3.a: Absolutely. Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also track your order anytime at ezihubb.com/orders/track.

q4.a: We ship to 30+ countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination. Enter your address at checkout for an exact quote. Note: customs duties may apply for international orders.

q5.q: My order says "delivered" but I haven't received it — what should I do?
q5.a: First, check with neighbors and any safe spots around your property. If still missing, contact us within 7 days of the marked delivery date. We'll work with the carrier to locate it or send a replacement.

q1.q: Can I return a personalized item?
q1.a: Personalized items generally can't be returned because they're made just for you. However, if there's a defect, wrong personalization, or damage in shipping, we'll replace it for free or issue a full refund.

q2.q: What if I made a typo in my personalization?
q2.a: We print exactly what you enter — typos included. Please double-check all text before ordering. If you notice an error within 2 hours of ordering, contact us immediately.

q3.a: Once approved, refunds are processed within 2–3 business days. Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 3–5 business days to appear on your statement.

q1.q: Do I need an account to order?
q1.a: No, you can check out as a guest. However, creating an account lets you track orders, save addresses, and access your customization history — making future orders faster.

q2.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q2.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Gift cards purchased from us can also be applied at checkout.

q3.a: Yes. We use Stripe for payment processing — one of the most secure payment platforms available. We never store your full card details on our servers.

craft.title: We Craft It Just for You

delivery.title: Fast, Safe Delivery

secure.title: Secure Checkout

onTime.title: On-Time Delivery

support.title: 24/7 Support

ourStory.subtitle: EziHubb was born from a simple belief: the best gifts are the ones that tell a story — your story.
ourStory.aboutP1: EziHubb exists because too many gifts on the market feel generic, mass-produced, and forgettable. We wanted to make it easy to give something that actually feels personal — a custom mug with an inside joke, a canvas print of a meaningful place, an ornament engraved with a special date.
ourStory.aboutP2: Every design is created in-house and printed to order — nothing sits pre-made in a warehouse waiting to be sold. That's what lets us keep every item personal to the person receiving it.

story.title: Every Gift Has a Story
story.desc: We believe the most meaningful gifts capture real moments, real relationships, and real love. That's why every item we create starts with your story.

quality.title: Quality Without Compromise

defective.title: Defective or damaged items

wrongPersonalization.title: Wrong personalization

contact.title: Contact us within 30 days

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, and how you can control it.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us and information we collect automatically when you use the Platform.
providedItems: Account details: name, email address, password, and profile photo.
Payment information: billing address and payment method details (processed securely by our payment partners — we do not store card numbers).
Shipping information: delivery addresses for orders.
Content you upload: product photos, personalization files, review text, and messages.
Communications: messages you send to our support team.
automaticItems: Usage data: pages visited, search queries, clicks, and time spent on the Platform.
Device data: browser type, operating system, IP address, and device identifiers.
Location data: approximate location inferred from IP address.
Transaction data: order history, amounts, and timestamps.
Cookies and similar tracking technologies (see Section 4).

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Create and manage your account.
Process transactions and payments for your orders.
Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts.
Respond to your questions and provide customer support.
Personalize your experience and surface relevant products.
Send marketing communications (with your consent, where required).
Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and other unauthorized activity.
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.
Analyze usage patterns to improve the Platform.
Communicate Platform updates, policy changes, and important notices.
howWeUse.legalBasisBody: For users in the European Economic Area, our legal bases for processing are: contract performance (order fulfillment), legitimate interests (fraud prevention, platform improvement), consent (marketing emails), and legal obligation (tax records).

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing & Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in the following circumstances:
sharing.providersBody: We work with trusted third parties to operate the Platform, including payment processors (Stripe), shipping carriers (EasyPost), email delivery (SendGrid), cloud hosting (Cloudflare R2), and analytics. These providers are contractually bound to protect your data.
sharing.legalReasonsBody: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government authority, or if we believe disclosure is necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of EziHubb, our users, or the public.
sharing.transfersBody: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of our assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you before your data becomes subject to a different privacy policy.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the Platform, remember your preferences, and analyze usage.

marketing.purpose: Personalised ads and retargeting (Meta Pixel, Pinterest Tag)

cookies.outro: You can manage cookie preferences via our Cookie Banner or your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may impact Platform functionality.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.p1: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including TLS encryption for data in transit, AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest, and regular security audits.
security.p2: Access to personal data is restricted to employees and contractors who need it to perform their duties, and all such personnel are bound by confidentiality obligations.
security.p3: Despite our efforts, no security measure is perfect. If you believe your account has been compromised, please contact us immediately at security@ezihubb.com.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Privacy Rights
yourRights.intro: Depending on where you live, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

access.desc: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.

deletion.desc: Request deletion of your personal data.

portability.desc: Receive your data in a machine-readable format.

restriction.desc: Limit how we process your data in certain situations.

objection.desc: Object to processing based on legitimate interests.

optOut.desc: Opt out of marketing emails at any time.

withdrawConsent.desc: Withdraw consent where processing is consent-based.

yourRights.contactP: To exercise any of these rights, email us at privacy@ezihubb.com. We will respond within 30 days (or as required by applicable law). We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling your request.
yourRights.euP: If you are in the EU/EEA, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active, plus any additional period required to comply with legal obligations (such as tax record-keeping), resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
retention.p2: Specifically: account data is kept for 2 years after account closure; transaction records are kept for 7 years for tax purposes; marketing consent records are kept for 5 years.
retention.p3: You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by going to Account → Settings → Delete Account, or by emailing privacy@ezihubb.com.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.p1: The Platform is not directed to children under 13 years of age, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected information from a child, please contact us immediately and we will delete it.
children.p2: For users between 13 and 18, we encourage parental or guardian review and supervision of Platform use.

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.p1: EziHubb operates from Vietnam. If you are located outside Vietnam, your information may be transferred to and processed in Vietnam or other countries where our service providers operate.
international.p2: For transfers from the European Economic Area (EEA) or United Kingdom, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission to ensure an adequate level of data protection.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of material changes via email or a prominent notice on the Platform.
changes.p2: We encourage you to review this Policy periodically. The "Last updated" date at the top indicates when the most recent changes were made.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:
contact.euNote: EU/UK users may also contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@ezihubb.com.

why.q: Why do I need EziHubb Payments for my shop?
why.a: To give buyers a better experience, EziHubb requires all eligible sellers to offer EziHubb Payments in their shop. This lets buyers pay using their preferred method in shops across the marketplace, and lets us provide direct payment support when you need it.

howToAdd.q: How do I add EziHubb Payments to my shop?
howToAdd.a: Go to Seller Hub → Finances → Payment settings. You'll be asked for your bank account and address so we know where to send your deposits. It takes less than 10 minutes.

fees.q: What are the fees for using EziHubb Payments?
fees.a: It's free to enroll. Payment processing fees are 5% + $0.25 USD per sale, calculated on the item price plus shipping. See your Finances dashboard for a full breakdown of every fee on every order.

countries.q: Is EziHubb Payments available in my country?
countries.a: EziHubb Payments supports deposits in more than 20 currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, and AUD. Choose your currency under Payment settings → Currency.

cta.title: Ready to start selling?
cta.subtitle: Open your shop and start accepting payments in minutes.
